permissions.description: Expense claims and their expense lines

actions.description: Create and edit the caller's own claims
Submit the caller's own claim for approval
The claims of the caller's direct reports
Approve or return a submitted claim awaiting the caller
Every manager-approved claim in the finance queue
Approve every claim for export, download the payroll file, and see export history

groups.name: Employees
groups.description: Everyone on staff who files expense claims

groups.name: Managers
groups.description: Staff with direct reports who approve their team's claims

groups.name: Finance
groups.description: The finance team that reviews claims and runs the payroll export

roles.name: Employee
roles.description: Any staff member: drafts, submits and tracks their own expense claims and corrects returned ones.

roles.name: Manager
roles.description: An employee with direct reports: sees the claims awaiting their approval and approves or returns each one.

roles.name: FinanceReviewer
roles.description: A finance team member (the PRD actor 'Finance team member'): reviews manager-approved claims, returns faulty ones for correction, approves claims for export and downloads the payroll file.
